external_evidence.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces
external_evidence.direct_finding_used: A steering gain under one answer encoding does not by itself identify the semantic variable controlled; cross-encoding evaluation can reveal extraction-index following.

external_evidence.title: Do LLMs Overcome Shortcut Learning? An Evaluation of Shortcut Challenges in Large Language Models
external_evidence.direct_finding_used: LLMs can rely on dataset shortcuts and exhibit impaired robustness/generalization under shortcut-laden conditions.

external_evidence.title: Data Laundering: Artificially Boosting Benchmark Results through Knowledge Distillation
external_evidence.direct_finding_used: Knowledge distillation can transfer benchmark-specific knowledge without genuine capability, so distillation does not itself sanitize provenance or shortcut contamination.

research_delta.hypothesis: A Global J-Space steering intervention can appear causally effective while actually controlling an answer carrier, extraction index, serialization choice or other output-sensitive nuisance rather than the intended semantic state.
research_delta.counterhypothesis: If the J-Space vector represents the intended semantic process, its intervention effect should survive semantics-preserving re-encodings and carrier permutations while remaining selective under off-target controls.
research_delta.cheapest_discriminator_after_upstream_p0: Freeze the exact model/checkpoint/runtime/site/vector construction and held-out items; permute answer identifiers, carrier vocabulary and presentation order without changing semantic labels; require the semantic intervention effect to remain aligned with the remapped semantic target rather than original extraction index. Include matched-norm null/random-direction and off-target behavior controls.
research_delta.promotion_rule: Decodability or same-encoding steering gain is insufficient for positive J-Space causal credit. Promotion requires cross-encoding/carrier invariance or an explicitly bounded claim identifying the actual controlled variable, plus preregistered lesion/rescue/off-target controls at exact model/runtime/site identity.
research_delta.distillery_implication: Do not distill same-encoding steering traces as positive semantic supervision until carrier/encoding nuisance is controlled; otherwise the student may inherit a shortcut while appearing to inherit J-Space semantics.
